organised-zombies-talking-to-elias-white.text: If the player did not speak to Elias at the Uzer Oasis prior to 21 February 2024:

steps.player: Hello there.

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Good day to you.

steps.player: What brings you here?

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: The eternal quest for knowledge, of course! The name's Elias White. I'm something of an explorer.

steps.player: Pleased to meet you. I'm [player name]. So you're searching for knowledge in an inn?

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Not exactly. In fact, I was previously hunting down information on an ancient race deep within the desert.

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: However, I received an interesting yet concerning tip- off from a contact of mine regarding some of my research. I came here to investigate for myself.

organised-zombies-talking-to-elias-white.text: If the player spoke to Elias at the Uzer Oasis before 21 February 2024:

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Oh, hello there. You look familiar. Have we met before?

steps.player: I think so. The name's [player name]. You're Elias, right? You had a camp out near Uzer.

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Ah, of course. You offered to help with my work, didn't you? I'm still very keen to take you up on that offer at some point, but a more pressing matter has delayed that somewhat.

steps.player: Is that what's brought you here?

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Indeed. I recived an interesting yet concerning tip-off from a contact of mine regarding some of my research. I came here to investigate for myself.

organised-zombies-talking-to-elias-white.text: If the player does not meet the quest's requirements:

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: How kind of you to offer. I'm not in need of any extra help right now though.

organised-zombies-talking-to-elias-white.text: If the player meets the quest's requirements:

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: How kind of you to offer. I definitely wouldn't complain about some extra support, if you're sure you're interested?

organised-zombies-talking-to-elias-white.prompt: Start the Defender of Varrock quest?

options.text: Yes.

steps.player: Absolutely! So what was this tip-off you received?

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: It's nothing much, but apparently one of the patrons in here was ranting and raving about zombies. Most just dismissed him as having had one too many, but I'm not so sure.

steps.player: How come?

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Varrock has an interesting history when it comes to zombies. Tell me, what do you know of Arrav?

steps.player: Arrav? As in the Shield of Arrav? I was the one who helped return it to the museum.

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Ah, I heard about that. Excellent work! You may well know then that the former owner of that shield, Arrav himself, once defended Varrock against a zombie invasion led by a Mahjarrat named Zemouregal.

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Arrav sacrificed himself to save his city, but Zemouregal survived.

steps.player: And you think these zombie sightings mean he's returned?

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Apparently the zombies were seen forming ranks. Zombies don't naturally organise themselves, so someone must be organising them. I can think of worse candidates than Zemouregal.

steps.player: I can see why you think this is worth looking into. Where do we start?

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Zombies are not particularly light on their feet, so my hope is we can pick up their trail. The sightings were apparently right outside the inn.

steps.player: Follow the tracks and see where they came from. Good plan.

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Then shall we get started?

options.text: Ready when you are.

steps.player: Ready when you are.

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Excellent! I'm right behind you.
(Elias begins to follow the player.)

options.text: Let's get going

steps.player: Let's get going.

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Lead the way.

options.text: What can you tell me about Arrav and Zemouregal?

steps.player: What can you tell me about Arrav and Zemouregal?

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: It's quite the tale and I doubt I'd be able to do it justice, but I can try and give you an overview.

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Back in the Fourth Age, a group of travellers came upon an abandoned child. It is said the child was unusual for one so young. Dark eyes and a fierce countenance, yet fair hair and skin, with a kind smile.

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: The travellers saw this as an omen and set up camp where they found him. The camp soon grew into the town of Avarrocka, or Varrock as we now call it.

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: As for the child, he grew to become a mighty hero. After defending the town from a goblin attack, he took on the name Arrav, a curse word in goblin tongue, for he had become the Curse of Goblins.

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Arrav's heroic deeds continued, until he was granted a vision of the future. He saw the Mahjarrat Zemouregal claiming Avarrocka as his own.

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Determined to stop Zemouregal in any way he could, Arrav set out to find a powerful weapon with which to best him. His journey took him to the Imcando Dwarves, who granted him a powerful shield.

steps.player: The Shield of Arrav?

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Exactly. With the shield in hand, Arrav returned home and faced off against Zemouregal and his zombie horde. Thanks to him, the invasion was repelled, but at the cost of Arrav's life.

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Zemouregal has not been seen since, but it is said that his last act before retreating was to claim Arrav's body, promising to turn him into an undead slave to one day return with.

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Hundreds of years have now passed, and while there are few who haven't heard of Arrav, many have forgotten Zemouregal and his promise.

options.text: So what exactly is it you're researching?

steps.player: So what exactly is it you're researching?

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: The Mahjarrat. It's fair to say they are quite the subject of fascination for me. Many of them once held dominion over huge parts of the world. Zamorak himself was a Mahjarrat, and he managed to achieve godhood!

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: But now, they've all but vanished! Most will go through their whole lives without ever seeing one, and their most common appearance these days is in the spooky stories parents use to keep their children in line.

steps.player: And that's why you're so interested in Zemouregal?

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Indeed. An actual Mahjarrat, and a very dangerous one at that. Ancient tomes can only teach us so much. If I want to learn everything there is to know about their race, it's going to take some more hands on work.

steps.player: What about the danger?

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Well that's just all the more reason for me to be here. If Zemouregal is planning a new attack on Varrock, an expert on his race might come in quite useful.

options.text: If you're an explorer, I'm guessing you travel a lot?

steps.player: If you're an explorer, I'm guessing you travel a lot?

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Indeed! From the frozen wastes of the north to the ancient tombs of the desert, I've seen it all.

steps.player: So where do you call home?

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: I've lived in many places over the years, but I wouldn't really say I have a home. I guess here in Varrock would be the closest answer.

steps.player: Sounds like you have quite the history.

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Oh yes! If nothing else, I've definitely lived a varied life.

steps.player: So you weren't always an explorer?

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Not at all. I've done all sorts of things in my time. In fact, at one point I was an adventurer like you!

steps.player: What happened? Some sort of life-changing injury?

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Thankfully not. I just found that when it came to my work, it was the history I discovered that interested me more than the treasure.

steps.player: Fair enough.

options.text: I need to do something else.

steps.player: I need to do something else.

options.text: I need to do something else first.

steps.player: I need to do something else first.

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Very well. I'll be here when you're ready.

options.text: No.

steps.player: Actually, I think I'll pass.

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Very well. If you change your mind, I'll be here.

organised-zombies-talking-to-elias-white.player: Hello again. So what was this tip-off you received?

organised-zombies-talking-to-elias-white.speaker: Elias White
organised-zombies-talking-to-elias-white.text: It's nothing much, but apparently one of the patrons in here was ranting and raving about zombies. Most just dismissed him as having had one too many, but I'm not so sure.

organised-zombies-talking-to-elias-white.speaker: Elias White
organised-zombies-talking-to-elias-white.text: Ready to get back to it? My hope is we can pick up the trail left by those zombies right outside the inn.

options.text: Let's get going.
Do you have that key we found?

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Very well. I'll meet you back at the Jolly Boar Inn.

organised-zombies-inspecting-the-plant-n.text: Look! Footprints. Let's see where they lead us.

organised-zombies-inspecting-any-incorre.text: Nothing seems out of place here.

organised-zombies-inspecting-the-plant-w.speaker: Elias White

organised-zombies-destroying-the-grubby-.text: Why are you trying to destroy that? We need it. I can look after it for you if you want?

the-infamous-necromancer-killing-an-armo.text: A strange red mist rises from the dying zombie.

the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.speaker: Sharathteerk
the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.text: Zemouregal, this magical mist feels like it's corroding my insides. This seems like a bad idea...

the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.speaker: Zemouregal
the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.text: Nonsense! The mist has no side effects. Besides, it's essential for the new security system. Everyone needs to be imbued with it if they wish to pass through any doors or gates in the base.

the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.speaker: Zemouregal
the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.text: Now, what news do you bring from the north?

the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.speaker: Sharathteerk
the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.text: Your cousin grows unusually strong. We should consider allying ourselves to him, maybe even combine forces.

the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.speaker: Zemouregal
the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.text: Combine forces? I won't hear of it! Lucien would never enter into such an arrangement unless he were the one in control, and I have no desire to serve at his behest.

the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.speaker: Zemouregal
the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.text: Besides, Lucien isn't the only one with powerful resources...

the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.speaker: Elias White
the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.text: Arrav. So the stories are true. The legendary hero of Avarrocka, now the slave of a disgusting necromancer.

the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.speaker: Zemouregal
the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.text: After many long years, it is time for Arrav to take command of my zombie troops. And on that note, come, let us inspect the forces.

the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.speaker: Elias White
the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.text: I see it's just as I suspected. Zemouregal is the one responsible for our zombie gatherings. We should inform the authorities in Varrock at once.

the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.player: What about the rest of this place? There could be more useful information to uncover here.

the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.speaker: Elias White
the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.text: True. Perhaps it would be wise for us to split up.

the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.player: Sounds like a plan. You head to Varrock and let them know what we've found so far. I'll keep exploring.

the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.speaker: Elias White
the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.text: Very well. I'll meet you in the palace once you're done. Be careful.
There doesn't seem to be a lot going on down there.

the-infamous-necromancer-opening-the-fir.text: If the player does not have any bottles of red mist:

steps.text: The gate is locked.

the-infamous-necromancer-opening-the-fir.text: If the player has less than three bottles of red mist:

steps.text: The gate seems to respond to the mist bottles you're carrying, but it remains locked. Perhaps more are needed.

the-infamous-necromancer-opening-the-fir.text: If the player has three bottles of red mist:

steps.text: The gate absorbs the mist from the bottles you're carrying, unlocking in the process.

the-infamous-necromancer-upon-entering-t.speaker: Arrav
the-infamous-necromancer-upon-entering-t.text: You... You must leave this place. It's too... urgh...

the-infamous-necromancer-upon-entering-t.speaker: Arrav
the-infamous-necromancer-upon-entering-t.text: ... too dangerous for the likes of you here.

the-infamous-necromancer-upon-entering-t.player: Arrav? But how are you... Are you fighting Zemouregal's control?

the-infamous-necromancer-upon-entering-t.speaker: Arrav
the-infamous-necromancer-upon-entering-t.text: My body is... under his control. I can sometimes manage to speak when Zemouregal's concentration is elsewhere, but even then, it's... painful. My mind, however... gahh...

the-infamous-necromancer-upon-entering-t.speaker: Arrav
the-infamous-necromancer-upon-entering-t.text: ... is still intact. He left it that way. He wanted me to feel the horror when I... urgh...

the-infamous-necromancer-upon-entering-t.player: I'm so sorry, Arrav. There must be some way I can help you. What can I do?

the-infamous-necromancer-upon-entering-t.speaker: Arrav
the-infamous-necromancer-upon-entering-t.text: My heart... He has it. That's how he... how he... arrgh...

the-infamous-necromancer-upon-entering-t.speaker: Arrav
the-infamous-necromancer-upon-entering-t.text: I'm sorry, he calls to me. I must go. Please, leave... Leave before you...

the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.speaker: Sharathteerk
the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.text: I'm telling you, he may be close to finding it.

the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.speaker: Zemouregal
the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.text: Enough! I don't have time to worry about fairy tales.

the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.speaker: Sharathteerk
the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.text: But think of the power...

the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.speaker: Zemouregal
the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.text: Do you not think that I am all too aware of the power? You couldn't begin to imagine what I'd do to have it for myself! But I am also all too aware of what happens to those who try to claim it.

the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.speaker: Zemouregal
the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.text: If that is the fate Lucien wishes for himself, then he is welcome to it. In the meantime, we will focus on more practical endeavours. This is our last chance before the time comes to head north.

the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.speaker: Sharathteerk
the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.text: Your forces are ready, Zemouregal.

the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.speaker: Zemouregal
the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.text: Then let us waste no more time. Begin the final preparations.

the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.speaker: Zemouregal
the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.text: Soon, the Mahjarrat will hold dominion over these lands once more. Varrock will be mine. Arrav cannot save his people this time. He can only watch as he himself seals their fate!

the-infamous-necromancer-looking-over-th.player: This isn't good. I'd better get to Varrock right away!

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.speaker: Elias White
the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.text: Ah, there you are. How did things go after I left you?

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.player: Not good. Zemouregal is nearly ready to begin another attack on Varrock.

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.speaker: Elias White
the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.text: Then it's just as I feared. I've already reported our discovery to Captain Rovin. Come, let's fill him in on everything else you've learnt.

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.speaker: Captain Rovin
the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.text: About time, adventurer. Your companion here tells me we have a zombie army on our doorstep!

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.speaker: Elias White
the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.text: I'm afraid that's not all, Captain. [player name] has made some further discoveries.

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.player: Indeed. Zemouregal plans to have Arrav lead the zombies in an attack on Varrock, and he plans to do so very soon.

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.speaker: Captain Rovin
the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.text: Zemouregal attacking Varrock again is our greatest fear and worst nightmare. And to think he now has Arrav under his control as well... What a horrifying fate for our greatest hero.

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.player: There may still be hope for Arrav. While spying on Zemouregal, I came face to face with him. He may serve Zemouregal, but not willingly. His mind is still his own.

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.speaker: Elias White
the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.text: A zombie with his mind intact... Most zombies are mere husks, their souls having long departed their bodies. For one to still be sentient is highly unusual. Could it mean...

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.speaker: Elias White
the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.text: Oh, nothing to worry about now. Still, we may be able to work with this. What did Arrav have to say to you?

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.player: He told me that Zemouregal has his heart.

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.speaker: Elias White
the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.text: His heart? Interesting... Could that be how Zemouregal is controlling him?

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.speaker: Captain Rovin
the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.text: What are you saying? Does this mean we might be able to save Arrav?

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.speaker: Elias White
the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.text: In the long term, potentially. But this will require a fair amount of research. Something I fear we have little time for right now.

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.speaker: Captain Rovin
the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.text: Well then what other options do we have?

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.speaker: Elias White
the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.text: Well thanks to our good friend here, we have the very shield that was used to stop Zemouregal the first time he attacked.

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.speaker: Captain Rovin
the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.text: The Shield of Arrav? But is it really any use? Despite our attempts, we've never been able to unlock its power. Could it be that the legends were exaggerated and that it's just an ordinary shield?

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.speaker: Elias White
the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.text: To answer that, our best bet would likely be to seek out the creators of the shield: The Imcando Dwarves of Camdozaal.

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.speaker: Captain Rovin
the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.text: Hmm... but are the Imcando not extinct now?

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.player: Not quite. There are still a few out there, including one in Camdozaal. Ramarno is his name.

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.speaker: Captain Rovin
the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white.text: Well then what are we waiting for? [player name], speak to this Ramarno and seek his advice on how to use the shield to defend our city. In the meantime, we will prepare our defences.

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white-.speaker: Captain Rovin
the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white-.text: About time, adventurer. Your companion here tells me we have a zombie army on our doorstep!

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white-.speaker: Elias White
the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white-.text: You'd better head over to Camdozaal, [player name]. Time is not on our side.

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white-.speaker: Captain Rovin
the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white-.text: Adventurer. Have you been to Camdozaal yet?

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-elias-white-.player: No, not yet. I'll be on my way shortly.

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-ramarno.speaker: Ramarno
the-sacred-forge-talking-to-ramarno.text: Ah, [player name]. I'm sure you have plenty of questions. I will do my best to answer them.

options.text: What can I do here?
I need your help with a shield.

steps.player: I need your help with a shield.

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: A shield? What kind of shield?

steps.player: The Shield of Arrav. We've discovered that Zemouregal intends to attack the city of Varrock with a zombie army. It was the shield that stopped him last time.

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: Ah, and you are hoping to use it to do so again. I wish I could help you, but I know little of the shield and its power. It was created far before my time.

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: Still, I may have a way for you to learn what you need.

steps.player: How?

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: The Sacred Forge of course!

steps.player: But how will a forge help me?

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: The Sacred Forge is far more than a mere furnace! It is a powerful relic from a time when the gods still walked these lands.

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: Before Camdozaal's ruin, our sages would use the forge to guide our people. It is said the forge granted them access to the Dream Theatre, a place where they were blessed with visions of the past, present and future.

steps.player: I see. So how do I access this Dream Theatre?

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: The Forge will need powering, but normal barronite won't work for this. You'll need to obtain some imbued barronite. With that, provided the forge deems you worthy, you will be able to enter the Dream Theatre.

steps.player: And how do I get imbued barronite?

steps.speaker: Ramarno
steps.text: Head to the mines and mine yourself a barronite deposit. Once you have that, imbue it using the core of a chaos golem from the golem workshop.

options.text: What happened to the other Imcando Dwarves?
Can I use the Forge?
Never mind, I have no questions for now.

steps.player: How do I access the Dream Theatre?

steps.speaker: Ramarno

options.text: More options...

the-sacred-forge-inside-the-dream-theatr.speaker: Arrav
the-sacred-forge-inside-the-dream-theatr.text: What is this? I feel... free. I can speak without pain. How is this possible?

the-sacred-forge-inside-the-dream-theatr.player: We don't have much time. I'm talking to you from the Imcando Dream Theatre. I need to know how to use your shield.

the-sacred-forge-inside-the-dream-theatr.speaker: Arrav
the-sacred-forge-inside-the-dream-theatr.text: The shield... of course. What do you need to know?

the-sacred-forge-inside-the-dream-theatr.player: You used the shield to defeat Zemouregal's army before. How can we do it again?

the-sacred-forge-inside-the-dream-theatr.speaker: Arrav
the-sacred-forge-inside-the-dream-theatr.text: It was not I who used the shield. When I faced Zemouregal, I cast the shield to the son of Avarrocka's founder. Only then did the zombies meet their doom.

the-sacred-forge-inside-the-dream-theatr.speaker: Arrav
the-sacred-forge-inside-the-dream-theatr.text: It was his blood. The shield is tied to Avarrocka. Only one with the blood of the founder can use it.

the-sacred-forge-inside-the-dream-theatr.player: So if I can find his descendant...

the-sacred-forge-inside-the-dream-theatr.speaker: Arrav
the-sacred-forge-inside-the-dream-theatr.text: Then you can save my home.

the-sacred-forge-inside-the-dream-theatr.speaker: Arrav
the-sacred-forge-inside-the-dream-theatr.text: Wait... It's him! He knows you're here!
The vision of Arrav transforms into Zemouregal.

the-sacred-forge-inside-the-dream-theatr.speaker: Zemouregal
the-sacred-forge-inside-the-dream-theatr.text: And what do we have here? Now, this is interesting... A snooping adventurer!

the-sacred-forge-inside-the-dream-theatr.speaker: Zemouregal
the-sacred-forge-inside-the-dream-theatr.text: So you hope to stop me do you, you pathetic human wretch? Well my zombie army is at the walls of Varrock. You are already too late!
The player finds themselves back in reality.

the-sacred-forge-inside-the-dream-theatr.player: I know how to use the shield!
Now I need to get back to Varrock as fast as possible. I just hope I'm not too late.

the-sacred-forge-talking-to-ramarno-afte.speaker: Ramarno

the-true-descendant-upon-entering-varroc.player: Oh this is not good! I need to find Elias and Captain Rovin!

the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.speaker: Sir Prysin
the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.text: Where did all these zombies come from?

the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.player: Don't worry, I'm working on a plan to get rid of them.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.speaker: King Roald
the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.text: Whatever you want, adventurer, it will need to wait. In case you hadn't noticed, there are zombies all over the palace!

the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.player: I'm sorry, Your Majesty. I'm trying to get rid of them.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.speaker: King Roald
the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.text: Well get to it then, rather than standing there yapping at me!

the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.speaker: Aeonisig Raispher
the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.text: What's going on? Where have all these zombies come from?

the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.player: They're an army belonging to Zemouregal.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.speaker: Queen Ellamaria
the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.text: What are all these horrible, icky zombies doing in my nice, clean palace? You! You're an adventurer! Get out there and sort this out!

the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.speaker: Reldo
the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.text: What's happening? Where did all these zombies come from?

the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.player: It's an army of zombies belonging to Zemouregal.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.speaker: Reldo
the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.text: Ah... that is bad news indeed.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.player: I'm working on a way to get rid of them, so fingers crossed.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.speaker: Ambassador Ferrnook
the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.text: Why are there zombies all over the place? Is this normal in Misthalin?

the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.player: Not really. Normally they stick to caves and sewers.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.speaker: Ambassador Ferrnook
the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.text: Well I hope they get removed soon. This isn't very safe.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.player: Don't you think you should try and get to somewhere safer?

the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.speaker: Ambassador Ferrnook
the-true-descendant-talking-to-npcs-upon.text: Well, I'd prefer to wait it out, but if someone doesn't deal with these things soon, I may have to.

the-true-descendant-returning-to-elias-o.speaker: Captain Rovin
the-true-descendant-returning-to-elias-o.text: About time you showed up! The zombies have breached the northern wall and are swarming the palace! We've managed to keep them from moving on the rest of Varrock for now, but we won't be able to do so forever!

the-true-descendant-returning-to-elias-o.speaker: Elias White
the-true-descendant-returning-to-elias-o.text: The situation isn't great, but all may not be lost. Did you manage to find out anything about how the shield works?

the-true-descendant-returning-to-elias-o.player: Sort of. I discovered that only a descendant of Varrock's original founder can use the shield, but I'm not sure how we'd find someone of that lineage still alive today.

the-true-descendant-returning-to-elias-o.speaker: Captain Rovin
the-true-descendant-returning-to-elias-o.text: The library would be your best bet. Get down there and see if Reldo can help you.
If the player does not have the Shield of Arrav:

steps.speaker: Captain Rovin

the-true-descendant-returning-to-elias-o.speaker: Captain Rovin
the-true-descendant-returning-to-elias-o.text: Then you should get down to the library and talk to Reldo. If we don't get this situation under control, Varrock is doomed, and I'd very much prefer it if that could be avoided.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-reldo.speaker: Reldo
the-true-descendant-talking-to-reldo.text: Surok Magis. The teleport block should have stopped him escaping, but it seems he was able to use the zombies as a distraction and disable the spell.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-reldo.speaker: Reldo
the-true-descendant-talking-to-reldo.text: In hindsight, imprisoning a deadly mage in a library was maybe not a very well thought out plan, but it seems we have bigger issues to deal with for now.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-reldo.player: You can say that again. Speaking of which, I need your help. I must find out if there are any living descendants of the founder of Varrock.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-reldo.speaker: Reldo
the-true-descendant-talking-to-reldo.text: I'm normally the first person to chat about local history, but given the situation, is now really the best time for this?

the-true-descendant-talking-to-reldo.player: Yes. This information may help us to defeat the zombies.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-reldo.speaker: Reldo
the-true-descendant-talking-to-reldo.text: Well in that case, I think I have what you need. There was a document on the desk in the corner listing the elders who sent Arrav on his original quest for the Shield of Arrav.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-reldo.speaker: Reldo
the-true-descendant-talking-to-reldo.text: One of those elders would have been the original founder of the city.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-reldo.player: Sounds like a good start, but how would that help me track down their descendants?

the-true-descendant-talking-to-reldo.speaker: Reldo
the-true-descendant-talking-to-reldo.text: Notable families like that are unlikely to have changed their surnames over the years. If you consult the latest census, you'll hopefully find some matching names. You'll find it just next to the desk.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-reldo-tal.speaker: Reldo
the-true-descendant-talking-to-reldo-tal.text: That document on the desk in the corner should be of use. It listed the names of the elders who sent Arrav on his original quest for the shield.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-reldo-tal.speaker: Reldo
the-true-descendant-talking-to-reldo-tal.text: If you cross-reference the document with the latest census, you should hopefully be able to find their descendants.

the-true-descendant-searching-for-the-de.text: The Shield of Arrav?

the-true-descendant-searching-for-the-de.player: Yes. A descendant of an original elder of Avarrocka can apparently use it to stop the zombies. You're one of those descendants, although I'm not sure if you're the right one.

the-true-descendant-searching-for-the-de.speaker: Sir Prysin
the-true-descendant-searching-for-the-de.text: Well, I suppose anything is worth a try.

steps.text: But I'm not actually a blood descendant of the Prysins. My great-grandfather, Wally, was adopted into the family.

steps.player: Interesting... So, are there any genuine Prysins around?

steps.speaker: Sir Prysin
steps.text: Well, none with the name Prysin. The last descendant of the Prysin line was a lady named Rhee Prysin. She married into the Fitzharmon family.

the-true-descendant-searching-for-the-de.speaker: King Roald

the-true-descendant-searching-for-the-de.player: It might be that you yourself can use it. I have a reason to believe that you are descended from an original elder of Avarrocka.

the-true-descendant-searching-for-the-de.speaker: King Roald

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: I'm flattered, but I'm sure I don't have the combat prowess for those kinds of shenanigans.

steps.player: Maybe not normally, but the Shield of Arrav might change that.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: I'm not sure the shield, nice as it is, will make that much difference.

steps.player: Well I have reason to believe that you are descended from an original elder of Avarrocka, which might mean you have the ability to use the shield. Here, hold it and see if anything happens.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Well, I've held it a few times in the course of my work, but I'll give it a go.
You pass the shield to Haig Halen, but nothing happens.
If Haig is not the correct person to talk to:

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Nothing special seems to be happening.

steps.player: It must be someone else who is descended from the correct elder then.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Well I wish you luck in finding them.
If Haig is the correct person to talk to:

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Nothing special seems to be happening. Why do you think I'm descended from an original elder of Varrock, anyway?

steps.player: Well, your surname is Halen. It matches the name of an elder called Marv Halen.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Now that is smart thinking, but I'm not actually a blood descendant of the original Halens. My great-grandfather was adopted into the family.

steps.player: Interesting... So, are there any genuine Halens around?

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: The last descendant of the Halen line that I know of was a lady named Edwina. She married into the Fitzharmon family.

steps.player: As in Dimintheis Fitzharmon? Sounds like I'd better pay him a visit.

options.text: Have you any interesting news?
Do you know where I could find any treasure?
How do I get a medallion?

the-true-descendant-searching-for-the-de.player: Romeo! I need to speak to you. A zombie army has invaded the palace and you might be the only one who's able to stop them.

the-true-descendant-searching-for-the-de.speaker: Romeo
the-true-descendant-searching-for-the-de.text: Ooh, do you really think I could? I've always wanted to be a hero!

the-true-descendant-searching-for-the-de.player: Well, I'm not sure. We might be able to find out with this shield though.

the-true-descendant-searching-for-the-de.speaker: Romeo
the-true-descendant-searching-for-the-de.text: Shield? What do you mean?

the-true-descendant-searching-for-the-de.player: I have reason to believe that you are descended from an original elder of Avarrocka, which might mean that you can use the Shield of Arrav to defeat the zombies. Here, hold it and see if anything happens.

the-true-descendant-searching-for-the-de.speaker: Romeo
the-true-descendant-searching-for-the-de.text: Ooh, okay, that sounds fun!
You pass the shield to Romeo, but nothing happens.
If Romeo is not the correct person to talk to:

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh... Nothing's happening.

steps.player: I guess it must be a different descendant that I'm after.

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: That's a shame. I would have quite liked to have been the one to use it.

the-true-descendant-searching-for-the-de.text: If Romeo is the correct person to talk to:

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh... Nothing's happening. Are you sure it was me who was meant to be using it?

steps.player: Well it wasn't a guarantee, but your surname matches that of an elder called Ramone Gontamue.

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh, well I'm not actually a real descendant of the Gontamues. My great-grandfather was adopted into the family.

steps.player: Interesting... So, are there any genuine Gontamues around?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Not exactly. The last descendant of the Gontamue line was Lilith Gontamue. She married into the Fitzharmon family.

steps.player: As in Dimintheis Fitzharmon? Sounds like I'd better pay him a visit.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-diminthei.text: If the player has not completed Family Pest:

options.text: Have you got any quests for me?
Other

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: You have my eternal gratitude for all you have done in saving my family's honour, adventurer. Perhaps some day my sons will overcome their differences.

options.text: Do you have any gauntlets for me?
I need your help with the zombie invasion.

steps.player: I need your help with the zombie invasion.

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: Well, I suppose I could help, but I am getting on a bit now. I'm not quite the warrior I used to be.

steps.player: I'm hoping the Shield of Arrav may help a little.

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: Ah, yes, I know of the shield's legend. I don't understand what that has to do with me though.

steps.player: I have reason to believe that you're descended from one of the original elders of Avarrocka, which might mean you have the ability to use the shield.

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: That doesn't sound entirely convincing, but I'll give it a go.
You pass the shield to Dimintheis and it magically responds to his touch.

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: Well, that is impressive.

steps.player: I think you might be the one! Quick, let's get to the palace!

steps.text: (Cutscene begins.)

the-true-descendant-talking-to-diminthei.text: If the player has completed Family Pest:

steps.player: Hello Dimintheis.

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: I will not forget what you did for my family, [player name]. Those 500,000 coins have allowed us to put food on the table.

steps.player: That's no problem.

options.text: Could I get another pair of gauntlets?
I need your help with the zombie invasion.
The gauntlets are a family heirloom?

the-true-descendant-talking-to-diminthei.text: If the player has not completed Family Pest:

options.text: Have you got any quests for me?
Other

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: You have my eternal gratitude for all you have done in saving my family's honour, adventurer. Perhaps some day my sons will overcome their differences.

options.text: Do you have any gauntlets for me?
I need your help with the zombie invasion.

steps.player: I need your help with the zombie invasion.

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: You want me to use the shield? It seems to be responding to me in some way! Is this what you were expecting?

steps.player: I think so! Quick, let's get to the palace!

steps.text: (Cutscene begins.)

the-true-descendant-talking-to-diminthei.text: If the player has completed Family Pest:

steps.player: Hello Dimintheis.

steps.speaker: Dimintheis
steps.text: I will not forget what you did for my family, [player name]. Those 500,000 coins have allowed us to put food on the table.

steps.player: That's no problem.

options.text: Could I get another pair of gauntlets?

the-true-descendant-defeating-the-zombie.text: A cutscene begins in which Dimintheis, wielding the shield, arrives at Varrock Palace.
Dimintheis unleashes the shield's power, instantly killing the zombies in the vicinity. The scene then changes to the imprisoned Monk of Zamorak, who has broken out.
The shield's power destroys the zombies inside the palace.
The scene changes to the palace garden.

the-true-descendant-defeating-the-zombie.speaker: Queen Ellamaria
the-true-descendant-defeating-the-zombie.text: Stay back! I won't let you eat me!
The shield's power destroys the zombies in the garden. The scene then changes to the broken wall north of the palace.

the-true-descendant-defeating-the-zombie.speaker: Sharathteerk
the-true-descendant-defeating-the-zombie.text: Zemouregal... The forces... What do we do?

the-true-descendant-defeating-the-zombie.speaker: Zemouregal
the-true-descendant-defeating-the-zombie.text: What do we do? We flee, you fool!

the-true-descendant-defeating-the-zombie.speaker: Zemouregal
the-true-descendant-defeating-the-zombie.text: Do you have a better suggestion? Are you hiding some secret to overcoming such an astounding disaster?

the-true-descendant-defeating-the-zombie.speaker: Zemouregal
the-true-descendant-defeating-the-zombie.text: Then recall Arrav at once! There is nothing more to be gained here. It is time for us to head north.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-elias-or-.speaker: Captain Rovin
the-true-descendant-talking-to-elias-or-.text: It seems the shield worked better than anyone could have hoped for. From what we can tell, not a single zombie remains! It was a close one, but thanks to you, Varrock is saved!

the-true-descendant-talking-to-elias-or-.player: It wouldn't have been possible without Dimintheis.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-elias-or-.speaker: Captain Rovin
the-true-descendant-talking-to-elias-or-.text: Indeed. I will ensure the King is made aware of his contribution.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-elias-or-.player: Any word on what happened to Zemouregal?

the-true-descendant-talking-to-elias-or-.speaker: Captain Rovin
the-true-descendant-talking-to-elias-or-.text: There's been no sign of him so far. We'll keep an eye out, but I suspect he'll have gone to ground.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-elias-or-.player: And he'll have Arrav with him.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-elias-or-.speaker: Elias White
the-true-descendant-talking-to-elias-or-.text: We may not have been able to save Arrav today, but thanks to your discoveries, we now have a lead to follow. It will take me some time, but once I have something on this heart business, I'll be in touch.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-elias-or-.speaker: Elias White
the-true-descendant-talking-to-elias-or-.text: And on that note, I intend to get started right away. Until we meet again.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-elias-or-.speaker: Captain Rovin
the-true-descendant-talking-to-elias-or-.text: Well once again, adventurer, on behalf of Varrock, you have my thanks. Today's victory will go down in history.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-elias-or-.speaker: Captain Rovin
the-true-descendant-talking-to-elias-or-.text: Now, you'd best be on your way. I have lots of work to do, and I'm sure you have better places to be than here.

the-true-descendant-talking-to-captain-r.speaker: Captain Rovin
the-true-descendant-talking-to-captain-r.text: Well once again, adventurer, on behalf of Varrock, you have my thanks. Today's victory will go down in history.

post-quest-dialogue-captain-rovin.speaker: Captain Rovin
post-quest-dialogue-captain-rovin.text: Oh, it's you. Thank you again for your help in defeating the zombie army.

post-quest-dialogue-captain-rovin.speaker: Captain Rovin
post-quest-dialogue-captain-rovin.text: Now, you must excuse me. I have lots to do.

post-quest-dialogue-elias-white.speaker: Elias White
post-quest-dialogue-elias-white.text: Ah, hello there, [player name]. Good to see you.
If the player did not speak to Elias at the Uzer Oasis prior to 21 February 2024:

steps.player: And you, Elias. So what brings you all the way out here?

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Well it turns out the desert was the best place to begin my research into Arrav and his heart. Not too surprising of course, given the burial practices here.

steps.player: And how's that going so far?

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Pretty well. In fact, I think I'm getting close to something. It's related to that old mastaba up on the plateau. I reckon it might contain the knowledge we need to help old Arrav out.

post-quest-dialogue-elias-white.text: If the player spoke to Elias at the Uzer Oasis before 21 February 2024:

steps.player: And you, Elias. So you're back out here again?

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Indeed. Turns out the desert was the best place to begin my research into Arrav and his heart. Not too surprising of course, given the burial practices here.

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: In fact, as you might recall, I was here before to look into that old mastaba up on the plateau.

steps.player: Yes, I remember. You said it might contain important information on the Mahjarrat.

steps.speaker: Elias White
steps.text: Indeed I did. And I reckon it might also contain the knowledge we need to help old Arrav out.

post-quest-dialogue-elias-white.speaker: Elias White
post-quest-dialogue-elias-white.text: Now, I still have quite a bit of preparatory work to do before we consider heading inside, but once that's done, I'll be in touch.

post-quest-dialogue-elias-white.player: Sounds good. I'd best leave you to your work.

JW6I-J.speaker: Elias White
JW6I-J.text: You're back. Have you managed to make any progress?
